snippet.title: Season of Rhythm Trailer | Sky: Children of the Light
snippet.description:
Following the honors as Apple’s ‘iPhone Game of the Year’ and Mobile Game Awards’s ‘People’s Choice Award’, thatgamecompany kicks off 2020 in Sky with the unveiling of a new adventure season. 

Download the Season of Rhythm now to explore the in-game events, and roll up to the new-look icy Home base which is sure to prompt some fun-filled winter season memories with your friends!

Sky is available on the iOS App Store: http://bit.ly/PlaySkyiOS
Fans can now pre-register for Android on Google Play: http://bit.ly/PreregisterSky

Visit our website thatskygame.com, and stay tuned for more news via our social media:
https://twitter.com/thatskygame
https://www.facebook.com/thatskygame
https://www.instagram.com/thatskygame
